meaning.en: Heroes keep emerging, generation after generation.
meaning.zh: 英雄人物一批接一批地不断出现。

examples.zh: 那是一个英雄辈出的年代。
examples.en: That was an age in which heroes emerged one after another.

examples.zh: 这支球队青训出色，年轻球星英雄辈出。
examples.en: The club's youth system is excellent, and young stars keep emerging.

usage.en: Often as attributive 英雄辈出的时代.
usage.zh: 常作定语，如“英雄辈出的时代”。

meaning.en: One's own life and one's family's livelihood; everything one has at stake.
meaning.zh: 个人的生命和家庭的财产、生计，泛指自己最宝贵的一切。

examples.zh: 他把身家性命都押在了这笔生意上。
examples.en: He staked everything he had on this deal.

examples.zh: 这关系到全村人的身家性命。
examples.en: The lives and livelihoods of the whole village are at stake.

meaning.en: To get a good result by sheer luck or by accident.
meaning.zh: 打法不对，却恰好打中；比喻方法本来不对，却碰巧得到了好结果。

examples.zh: 我随便填的答案，居然歪打正着，全对了。
examples.en: The answers I filled in at random turned out right by pure luck.

examples.zh: 这次改版歪打正着，用户反而更多了。
examples.en: The redesign worked by accident, and we gained more users.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，口语色彩。

meaning.en: A desperate fight in which both sides are ruined.
meaning.zh: 鱼死了，网也破了；比喻双方拼到底，两败俱伤。

examples.zh: 对方再逼我，我就和他鱼死网破。
examples.en: If he keeps pushing me, I'll fight him to the bitter end.

examples.zh: 谈判破裂后，两家公司闹到了鱼死网破的地步。
examples.en: After talks collapsed, the two firms fought until both were ruined.

usage.en: Predicate; often 拼个鱼死网破.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“拼个鱼死网破”。

meaning.en: Unable to stop oneself, usually because of strong emotion.
meaning.zh: 无法控制自己的感情。

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，他激动得不能自已。
examples.en: On hearing the news, he was overcome with excitement.

examples.zh: 她悲痛不能自已，当场哭了出来。
examples.en: Overcome with grief, she burst into tears on the spot.

meaning.en: In a great hurry, anxious and agitated.
meaning.zh: 形容非常着急的样子。

examples.zh: 他火急火燎地赶到了医院。
examples.en: He rushed frantically to the hospital.

examples.zh: 别火急火燎的，时间还早呢。
examples.en: Don't get in such a flap; there's still plenty of time.

meaning.en: An indefinite, far-off time; used to say something will take forever.
meaning.zh: 不知哪年哪月，指遥远而不确定的时间，常含不耐烦或讽刺。

examples.zh: 照你这个速度，要干到猴年马月去？
examples.en: At this rate, goodness knows when you'll finish.

examples.zh: 房子什么时候修好，只能等到猴年马月了。
examples.en: The house will be repaired when pigs fly.

usage.en: Often 到猴年马月; ironic, colloquial.
usage.zh: 常说“到猴年马月”，带讽刺，口语。

meaning.en: To know a little about something (often said modestly).
meaning.zh: 稍微知道一点，多用作谦辞。

examples.zh: 对于中医，我略知一二。
examples.en: I know a little about traditional Chinese medicine.

examples.zh: 关于这件事，我只是略知一二。
examples.en: I only know a little about this matter.

literal: face · battle line · slip away · flee
natural: desert in the face of the enemy

meaning.en: To run away just as the battle begins; to bail out at the critical moment.
meaning.zh: 战斗临近或开始时逃跑，比喻在紧要关头退缩。

equivalents: bail out at the crucial moment

examples.zh: 比赛前夕队长临阵脱逃，大家都很失望。
examples.en: The captain bailed out on the eve of the match, and everyone was disappointed.

examples.zh: 士兵临阵脱逃要受军法处置。
examples.en: A soldier who deserts in battle is dealt with under military law.

meaning.en: Joy plainly showing on one's face.
meaning.zh: 内心的喜悦表现在脸上。

examples.zh: 听说中奖了，他喜形于色。
examples.en: On hearing he had won, he beamed with joy.

examples.zh: 她拿到录取通知书，不禁喜形于色。
examples.en: Receiving her offer letter, she couldn't help but show her delight.

natural: put a spoke in the wheel

meaning.en: To obstruct or sabotage something from behind the scenes.
meaning.zh: 在事情中间故意设置障碍，使事情不能顺利进行。

equivalents: put a spoke in the wheel
throw a wrench in the works

examples.zh: 这门亲事本来很顺利，却有人从中作梗。
examples.en: The match was going smoothly until someone sabotaged it.

examples.zh: 项目屡屡受阻，肯定是有人从中作梗。
examples.en: The project keeps being blocked; someone must be obstructing it.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“有人从中作梗”。

meaning.en: Treating life with a cynical, irreverent attitude.
meaning.zh: 用不严肃、不认真的态度对待生活。

examples.zh: 他表面玩世不恭，其实心地善良。
examples.en: He seems flippant, but he's actually kind-hearted.

examples.zh: 年轻人那种玩世不恭的态度让老板很头疼。
examples.en: The young man's devil-may-care attitude gives the boss a headache.

natural: be trapped in a trap of one's own making

meaning.en: To trap oneself by one's own actions.
meaning.zh: 蚕吐丝作茧，把自己包在里面；比喻自己束缚自己，或自己给自己制造麻烦。

examples.zh: 他撒了一个谎，又不得不编更多谎，真是作茧自缚。
examples.en: He told one lie and had to invent more; he really trapped himself.

examples.zh: 过度保守的政策只会让企业作茧自缚。
examples.en: An overcautious policy will only tie the company in knots.

natural: a single spark can start a prairie fire

meaning.en: A tiny spark can start a fire that sweeps the plain; a small force can grow into a great movement.
meaning.zh: 一点小小的火星可以燃成燎原大火，比喻新生的事物开始很弱小，但有旺盛的生命力，能迅速发展壮大。

equivalents: a spark that lights a prairie fire

examples.zh: 这场运动最初只是几个学生的行动，后来星火燎原。
examples.en: The movement began with a few students and then spread like wildfire.

examples.zh: 一条短视频引发讨论，形成星火燎原之势。
examples.en: One short video sparked a debate that quickly caught fire.

usage.en: Often 星火燎原之势; formal.
usage.zh: 常说“星火燎原之势”，多用于书面。

meaning.en: Extremely thin, with bones sticking out.
meaning.zh: 形容人或动物非常瘦，骨头突出。

examples.zh: 那只流浪狗瘦骨嶙峋。
examples.en: The stray dog was nothing but skin and bone.

examples.zh: 病了一场之后，他变得瘦骨嶙峋。
examples.en: After the illness he became gaunt.

meaning.en: The enjoyment of it is endless.
meaning.zh: 其中的乐趣没有穷尽。

examples.zh: 与孩子们一起做手工，其乐无穷。
examples.en: Making crafts with the children is endless fun.

examples.zh: 读书自有一种其乐无穷的享受。
examples.en: Reading brings a joy that never runs out.

meaning.en: To enter one after another in a single line.
meaning.zh: 像游鱼一样一个接一个地依次进入。

examples.zh: 观众鱼贯而入，会场很快坐满了。
examples.en: The audience filed in and the hall soon filled up.

examples.zh: 乘客们有序地鱼贯而入。
examples.en: Passengers boarded in an orderly line.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，可与“鱼贯而出”对应。

meaning.en: To turn a losing position into a win.
meaning.zh: 扭转败局，取得胜利。

equivalents: snatch victory from the jaws of defeat

examples.zh: 下半场球队反败为胜。
examples.en: The team turned the match around in the second half.

examples.zh: 他靠一个妙招反败为胜。
examples.en: One clever move turned his defeat into victory.

meaning.en: People coming and going in a busy crowd.
meaning.zh: 形容人来人往，非常热闹拥挤。

examples.zh: 节日的广场上熙来攘往。
examples.en: The square was bustling on the festival day.

examples.zh: 车站里熙来攘往，十分热闹。
examples.en: The station teemed with people coming and going.

meaning.en: To be fickle and manipulative, changing tactics at will.
meaning.zh: 翻手为云，覆手为雨；比喻反复无常，或玩弄权术手段。

examples.zh: 他在政坛翻云覆雨，没人敢信任他。
examples.en: He plays fast and loose in politics and nobody dares trust him.

examples.zh: 这个商人惯于翻云覆雨。
examples.en: That merchant is used to shifting ground whenever it suits him.

story.en: Du Fu's poem 'Ballad of Poor Friendship': 'Turn the hand and it is clouds, flip it and it is rain' (翻手作云覆手雨), about fickle friends.
story.zh: 杜甫《贫交行》：“翻手作云覆手雨，纷纷轻薄何须数。”

meaning.en: To go far away, especially to escape or to seek a new life.
meaning.zh: 跑到远处去，多指摆脱某种环境去寻找新的出路，或逃走。

examples.zh: 他大学毕业后就想远走高飞。
examples.en: After graduating he wanted to head far away.

examples.zh: 案发后，嫌疑人想远走高飞，被警方拦下。
examples.en: After the crime the suspect tried to flee far away but was stopped by police.

meaning.en: To use words very sparingly, whether in speech or in writing.
meaning.zh: 爱惜文字像爱惜金子一样，指说话或写文章极为简洁、不多费字。

examples.zh: 他在会上惜字如金，只说了三句话。
examples.en: He was sparing with words at the meeting and said only three sentences.

examples.zh: 这位作家惜字如金，文风极为凝练。
examples.en: The writer is economical with words, and his style is highly concise.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，中性或略带褒义。

meaning.en: To leave a harm that lasts for a very long time.
meaning.zh: 留下的祸害没有穷尽，影响极坏。

equivalents: a curse for years to come

examples.zh: 滥用抗生素将贻害无穷。
examples.en: Abusing antibiotics will cause lasting harm.

examples.zh: 这种短视的决策贻害无穷。
examples.en: Such short-sighted decisions have damaging effects for years to come.
